verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered-agent service gives access to state forms pre-filled with its agent address (docs-21), which covers preparing change-of-agent paperwork. It also offers help with the transition for customers mid-contract with another provider (docs-22). There is no evidence that it files the change-of-agent forms itself or documents each state's fee. Missing for 10: evidence that Harbor files change-of-agent paperwork on the customer's behalf, per-state fee documentation, an explicit per-state form catalog for agent changes, and independent corroboration.
